patterns.note: The hero section features an interactive canvas-based dot-matrix grid that dynamically renders the text 'Humanize Design' and reacts to user cursor movement.
Horizontal-scrolling card tracks are used to showcase portfolio items under distinct chronological headers, keeping the vertical scroll footprint compact and highly structured.
Oversized, high-contrast sans-serif headings paired with small, low-contrast metadata labels and monospaced system-like fonts for secondary details.
An ultra-dark, near-monochromatic palette (pure black background with white and muted gray text) that allows vibrant, colorful UI screenshots to pop.

technique_notes: To recreate the interactive hero, implement an HTML5 Canvas particle system where dots form the letter shapes of 'Humanize Design' and disperse or react to mouse hover coordinates.

Build the horizontal portfolio showcases using a CSS flex container with overflow-x scroll, styled with custom scrollbars or configured as a draggable carousel to allow seamless horizontal exploration of mobile UI mockups.
Use a sticky navigation bar that remains fixed at the top with minimal footprint (just logo, menu toggle, and theme switch) to maintain utility without distracting from the content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized bold headings (~4x body) with tiny uppercase monospaced labels and highly readable, medium-weight body copy.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle to rounded; cards and video containers use a soft rounded corner (~12px to 16px) contrasting with the sharp screen edges.
design_tokens.spacing: Airy and spacious, utilizing generous vertical margins between major portfolio sections to create an editorial, museum-like pacing.

standout: The standout feature is the interactive dot-matrix canvas hero that spells out 'Humanize Design', setting a highly technical yet tactile tone immediately upon arrival. This is paired with beautifully structured horizontal-scrolling case study tracks that keep the portfolio clean and highly scannable.
